target: generate causal GGG holdings from immutable free-data vintages after 2026-04-10

missing_runtime_components.reason: GGG sleeves consume the Version 1 signal and regime-feature schema, including momentum, quality, value, BAB, carry, and fallback regime features; the free pipeline currently emits only its independent five-signal strategy inputs.
The four qualified sleeves and recovered composite-regime fallback are currently generated by the Version 1 notebook, not by a platform-owned module that accepts a SnapshotStore vintage.
market_state_history, regime_states, and phase2b_meta_predictions are frozen CSV inputs ending 2026-04-10; their causal post-April generators have not been independently ported and pinned.
The existing GGG allocator accepts a price override but still reindexes frozen sleeve, state, and prediction artifacts, so new price rows alone cannot produce valid new holdings.

required_acceptance_gates: exact or tolerance-declared historical equivalence through 2026-04-10
three prefix-truncation or future-shock invariance checks for every generated input and final holding
row-t decisions use data available no later than t and earn only t-to-t+1 returns
fail closed on missing signals, state, prediction, or incomplete market weeks
no backfilling of a missed forward decision from a later vintage
recommended_sequence: port and reconcile the exact Layer 1 input schema
port the four already-qualified sleeve formulas and recovered composite fallback
port or replace Layer 2b only under a separate versioned equivalence decision
connect the portable outputs to ggg_independent.run_from_artifacts through an explicit input bundle
freeze a new GGG strategy/protocol version before its first eligible decision week
